_comment: Deterministic impact map used by Scripts/test.ps1 -Changed, Scripts/smoke_parallel.ps1 and Scripts/verify_all.ps1.
rules: a changed repo-relative path (forward slashes) is matched against every rule's globs ('**' = any dirs, '*' = within one path part).
All matching rules are merged. Order inside 'smokes' is priority: -Quick runs only the first 'quickCount' smokes of the merged list per rule.
tests: automation filters (prefix match, joined with '+' into ONE UnrealEditor-Cmd run). A rule with no tests/smokes is an explicit 'nothing to verify'.
smokeRegistry lists every smoke that verify_all runs; test.ps1 -CheckMap fails when a Debug/*SmokeCommand.cpp is missing here or a registered smoke maps to no rule.

smokeDefaults._comment: Clock of every smoke run by smoke_parallel.ps1 (cleanup day 2026-10-15): -UseFixedTimeStep -FPS=fixedStepFps (+ -FixedSeed): each frame advances the game by exactly 1/fps whatever the load (no frame-time dependent results with 3 games side by side) and, unthrottled, smokes run several times faster than real time. 60 fps: the smokes' step tickers (0.05 / 0.1 / 0.25 s, State.Time += step) land on whole frames, so their counters equal the game time (at 30 fps a 0.05 s ticker fires every 2 frames = 0.067 s and timed checks drift by 25 %: GrenadeAnimSmoke release times). 0 = wall clock. A smoke that needs the wall clock sets "realTime": true in smokeOptions; smoke_parallel -RealTime runs all of them on the wall clock.

knownFlaky._comment: Smokes known to pass only on a re-run, name -> reason (smoke_parallel prints them apart from NEW flaky ones). Goal: empty. Cleanup day 2026-10-15 fixed CornerHold, TurnBasedAim, Knockdown, Cover, LevelWave, GroupSelect, TurnBlastDeath, EnemyTactics (+ Panic, SquadControl, VisionCone failing) - see docs/port/KNOWN_GAPS.md (the old HANDOFF section 9).

smokeOptions._comment: exclusive = never alongside another game instance (shared Saved/ files); extra = additional UnrealEditor args; map = start map (default /Game/Maps/L_MovementTest); timeout in seconds; knownFail = reported but does not fail the run; realTime = wall clock instead of the fixed step (smokeDefaults); fixedStepFps = this smoke's own fixed step; rendered = a real RHI offscreen (-RenderOffscreen -ResX=1280 -ResY=720) instead of -nullrhi; _why = the reason of an override

TutorialAmbushLakeMineSmoke._why: 2026-10-23: part 1 by a mine - zombie #1 dormant until the squad is in cover, wakes hidden, the Engineer's mine kills it

TutorialAmbushLakeEarlyKillSmoke._why: 2026-10-22: the first PMC wire -> the tripwire card; both A4 zombies killed early -> every bound step closes (no stale target); A7 -> PREPARE THE GROUND

CornerHoldSmoke._why: ~200 s of game time (four horde phases + the peek passes): ~50 s wall on a free machine with the fixed step, but on the game clock under heavy CPU load (shader compiles) it can need more than the default 300 s

TurnBasedAimSmoke._why: its jitter metrics are per frame (max AimYaw step 8 deg, reversals over 0.5 deg): tuned at the uncapped headless rate; at 30 fps one FInterpTo step of a retarget is 25-32 deg

CoverMoveSmoke._why: per-frame pop check (max 20 cm of mesh travel away from the wall in one frame): 34 cm at 60 fps for the same eased arc

SniperSmoke._why: per-frame body yaw check (max 25 deg in one frame): 41.7 at 30 fps, 20.8 at 60 fps for the same turn

TutorialSmoke._why: the dialogue Enter hold (0.6 s skip) is timed on the wall clock (FPlatformTime, the dialogue pause freezes the game clock); a fixed step runs the game faster than the wall clock, so the held key is too short
